info.title: ONESOURCE Income Tax Charts API
info.description:
Charts are used to identify Tax Return Code (TRC) and Tax Combination Code (TCC) accounts and adjustments for multiple entities and binders. Use REST APIs to automatically manipulate basic chart functions.

The charts are related by using elements from other charts to create a set of charts. Each set of charts is then assigned to an entity to use for TRC/TCCs, accounts, and adjustments. Chart assignments are either Common or Separate.

delete.summary: Deletes an account in the FCOA. When deleting accounts, consider accounts that are mapped in the Federal Chart of Account Cross-Referencing. If you have previously mapped a Prior Year Federal COA account to the deleted account in the Current Year Federal COA, then you must remap to another account in the respective chart.
